title: Research: certify joint P104 unit-step endpoint flags (no new kappa)
body:
## Summary

PR2920's source and target endpoint covers were chosen separately. This package pairs those exact covers into one collection of 208 complete nested unit-step flags, closing its static joint-nesting question.

```text
208 departure planes + 208 arrival planes
  -> 2,309 exact containment edges
  -> perfect matching
  -> 208 explicit nine-vector bases and joint residual covers
```

This is a finite geometric certificate. It is not a 208-lifetime correction program and does not refute the reported stronger program-level lifetime floors. Chronological acquisition, coefficients, relay dependencies, dirty restoration, native lowering, hosting and the complete physical/consumer bill remain unresolved. No new supplier or kappa is claimed.

The isolated package is `research/p104-joint-unit-flags`. It includes exact source pins, full regeneration, a separate bitmap checker, rejecting controls and open next questions. Scientific base is `fadae6f469e0d5c9c03bbe047a4d383dac254448`; refreshed main `afb1af88d44eb072daf70053169f67d80317cb13` changes no relevant guidance or scientific inputs. Final live overlap covered 228 open PRs and 1,681 Discussion records, with complete pagination and the documented search limits.

Credit PR2920/2909/2896, PR2953, Sudarsh Chaturvedi/PR2924, Hiroki Kumazaki/PR2889/2353, ywz65/PR2614, Arham Tahir/PR2675/2682, Sagar Thakrar, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained P104 geometry/native lineage. Full attribution and assistance disclosure are in the package. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18977218).

## Evidence

- Before: exact separate endpoint covers, with joint nesting left open.
- After: an explicit perfect matching and full flags cover all 9,312 residual demand incidences. Independent reconstruction imports neither producer nor predecessor geometry.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-joint-unit-flags`.
- Optimized isolated CPython 3.14.8 checks and eight behavioral groups pass, including invalid flags/covers, duplicate slots, Hall failure, source-before-execution and a poisoned-cache control with a positive ordinary-loader check.
- Ruff, warnings-as-errors, metadata/source pins, exact committed-byte preflight and internal mathematical/artifact reviews pass. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** isolated.

Only a new opt-in research package is added. Frozen inputs, shared code and the selected frontier are unchanged. Complete execution and supplier-admission obligations remain open.
